summary: Reproduced all three review counterexamples against candidate 9e190f3070c97e9aa680919ed29d96ddf08239af, retained its valid Harmony and conversion fixes, and backported the seven-tier ReasoningEffort enum onto the pinned openai-protocol 1.0.0 source so Responses requests deserialize and forward none, minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, and max.

tests.what_was_measured: Before correction, production ResponsesRequest deserialization independently rejected none, xhigh, and max; see candidate-three-counterexamples.log.
At exact candidate commit, a production ResponsesRequest regression failed on none before conversion; see candidate-seven-tier-before.log.
After correction, two tests passed, including seven-tier production request deserialization and exact Responses-to-Chat forwarding.
Two Harmony tests passed, covering all seven tiers and the unknown-string fallback.
Seven existing reasoning-related API/parser tests passed.
Rust formatting check passed; stable rustfmt emitted only existing nightly-option warnings.
The gateway, smg-grpc-client, smg-mcp, and tool-parser all resolve to the same patched openai-protocol 1.0.0 path crate.

gpu_execution_evidence: rocminfo exposed gfx950, but GPU execution was intentionally not used because the reproduced failure is CPU-side JSON deserialization before handler and engine execution.
remaining_limitations: No model-quality, model-architecture, weighted serving, multi-node, or distributed-workload claim is made.
The local protocol compatibility backport remains necessary until an API-compatible published openai-protocol release includes smg-project/smg#2410.
